definitions.gloss: blood pressure monitor; blood pressure gauge
definitions.explanation: A medical device used to measure blood pressure. Available in both professional clinical models and home-use digital versions.

examples.japanese: {血圧計|けつあつけい}で{測|はか}ってください。
examples.english: Please measure with the blood pressure monitor.

examples.japanese: {家庭用|かていよう}の{血圧計|けつあつけい}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a home blood pressure monitor.

examples.japanese: {医師|いし}に{勧|すす}められて、{毎朝|まいあさ}{血圧計|けつあつけい}で{血圧|けつあつ}を{記録|きろく}している。
examples.english: On my doctor's recommendation, I record my blood pressure every morning with a blood pressure monitor.

notes:
Composed of {血圧|けつあつ} (blood pressure) and {計|けい} (gauge, meter). The suffix {計|けい} is productive and appears in many instrument names such as {体温計|たいおんけい} (thermometer) and {体重計|たいじゅうけい} (scale).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {血圧計|けつあつけい}で{測|はか}る (to measure with a blood pressure monitor)
- {家庭用|かていよう}{血圧計|けつあつけい} (home blood pressure monitor)
- {手首|てくび}{式|しき}{血圧計|けつあつけい} (wrist-type blood pressure monitor)
- {上腕|じょうわん}{式|しき}{血圧計|けつあつけい} (upper arm-type blood pressure monitor)
